title: Paramahansa Yogananda’s Kriya Yoga Teachings — With Brother Chidananda | 2026 SRF Convocation

# Paramahansa Yogananda’s Kriya Yoga Teachings — With Brother Chidananda | 2026 SRF Convocation

### Opening Invocation
Brother Chidananda begins the session by bowing to the lineage of the Gurus. "Divine Mother, Heavenly Father, Beloved Guru, Paramahansa Yogananda, saints of all religions, we humble ourselves in your presence. Bless this gathering that we may understand the divine science of Kriya Yoga not as a mere ritual, but as the direct path to the realization of the Soul."

### Introduction
The teachings of Paramahansa Yogananda are not just philosophy; they are a laboratory of the soul. Kriya Yoga is the 'jet-airplane' route to God-realization. Many come to the path looking for peace, but the Master invites us to something far greater: the permanent, immutable state of union with the Infinite.

**Story • The Architect of the Soul**

Story: Paramahansa Yogananda once shared an analogy about a master architect building a mansion. He said that most people spend their entire lives decorating the windows and doors of the outer house—their physical bodies, their social status, and their material possessions. But the master builder knows that the foundation is everything. Kriya Yoga is the act of digging down into the bedrock of the spine. When you align your consciousness with the divine current flowing through the cerebrospinal centers, the mansion of your soul becomes habitable for the Divine Presence. You are not just building; you are preparing a temple for God to inhabit.

### The Science of Kriya
Kriya is essentially the neutralization of the 'life-force eddies.' By controlling the prana (life-force) and directing it upward, the yogi slows down the metabolic rate and withdraws the consciousness from the senses. 

*   **Practical Instruction:** Always begin with the Hong-Sau technique to still the breath before moving into Kriya. The stillness is the bridge. Without the bridge of calmness, the Kriya is merely a physical practice. 
*   **The Guru's Promise:** Yogananda explicitly stated that the practice of Kriya for one minute is equivalent to one year of natural spiritual evolution. This is not hyperbole; it is the mathematical precision of yogic science.

### Guided Visualization: The Astral Tunnel
Brother Chidananda leads the audience in a brief meditation. "Focus at the point between the eyebrows. Imagine a tunnel of light stretching through the spine. As you inhale, draw the life-force up from the base of the spine, passing through the chakras, until it bursts like a star at the spiritual eye. Feel the weight of the world falling away. You are not the body; you are the light-bearer."

### Closing Blessings
May the light of Kriya illuminate your darkest nights. May the Guru’s grace sustain you when the ego protests. Know that you are never alone. The lineage is with you. Om, Tat, Sat.
